title: Coming home for the harvest - notes on slow living
en: i am finally back home just in time for the beginning of the harvest season it's incredible how much my valley changes from spring to summer luscious greens and abundant meadows dry out into crisp prairies of bitterroot and sage during my trip i made the decision to disconnect from technology as much as possible i thought i'd share some ways that i use technology and social media to benefit me instead of weighing down my mind or demotivating me which happens i find if i use it too much

since i recently made a video on this topic i thought i'd expand into more practical ways i enrich my reality so that the world in my phone seems far less important in regards to who i am and how i spend my time one very simple way i disconnect is by finding ways to incorporate more movement in my days walking somewhere stretching using my phone for example often leaves me very stationary and affects my posture and neck if i'm hunched over too much by looking at my phone less i notice so many more things specifically the sky if you have the chance right now i would

encourage you to take a quick moment and run outside and look up the enormity of the sky is always wondrous and makes you feel small in the best way there is so much out there more than we will ever discover and it really puts things into perspective if an image or comment or anything at all is bothering me it suddenly seems so inconsequential and i really feel silly for wasting precious time over it the same is true for the insecurities that often arise from comparison it offers so little benefit and if anything it distracts you from the beauty of your own existence there is so much to experience in this world and within your spirit i wouldn't waste one more minute over something so small

another way i disconnect is by still actually using technology but just using it differently i find music and certain sounds incredibly calming and centering i also love listening to stories and watching movies that inspire me and looking at art in these ways i disconnect from the noise and notifications and messages and yet still can cultivate richness in my life through exposure to so much art and ideas

since being online more i've noticed people often recommend silent meditation as a means to feel more centered when the world seems hectic i respect anyone who can meditate for a long time and am happy to know how much it benefits some people but i have never been able to do it i live in a very quiet environment for the most part so meditation actually feels a little weird when in a rural area everything is already so still my way of meditating and being in touch

with myself is through movement my hands need to move and create and cook my mind needs to have something to focus on like written words or music or ideas it is when i'm my most creative that i'm also most at peace i find that through this i strengthen my spirituality i encourage you to find your best way to meditate as i don't think any specific form works for everyone meditation isn't limited to sitting in a room if anything i find that especially if you're not very active meditation through movement be it walking or hiking or even dance can have as much benefit depending on who you are whatever makes you feel most at ease and creative another way i disconnect is by not
fearing boredom this feeling has an incredible ability to inspire you with new ideas and interests and hobbies um

so lastly i always try to reserve my evenings as a time free of unwanted distractions i may watch a movie listen to a book or music while i do some tidying around my home it is a very special time for me and i

particularly enjoy lighting candles i recently discovered this adorable small business inspired by mythology and fantasy and i wanted to briefly mention how much i enjoy their candles i'll leave their website down below they're perfect for lovers of storytelling books fairies and imagination this is of course not sponsored i just really love these candles and wanted to share them with you i hope you have a wonderful day or night and i will see you next week sending my love my
zh: 我终于回到家，正好赶上收获季节的开始，令人难以置信的是，我的山谷从春天到夏天发生了多么大的变化，在我的旅行中，甘美的绿色和丰富的草地干燥成苦根和鼠尾草的脆草原我决定尽可能地脱离技术我想我应该分享一些我使用技术和社交媒体使我受益的方法，而不是压低我的思想或使我失去动力，如果我使用太多就会发生这种情况

因为我最近制作了一个关于这个主题的视频，所以我想我应该以更实用的方式扩展我的现实，这样我的手机中的世界对于我是谁以及我如何度过我的时间来说似乎远没有那么重要。一种非常简单的方式是我断开连接的一个非常简单的方法是找到方法在我的日子里融入更多的运动，例如，在某个地方散步，使用我的手机进行伸展运动，例如，经常让我保持静止状态，如果我弯腰驼背太多，那么会影响我的姿势和颈部，因为我会注意到更多的东西，特别是天空，如果你现在有机会的话，我会

鼓励你花点时间跑到外面，抬头仰望天空的伟大总是奇妙的，让你以最好的方式感到渺小，那里有比我们发现的更多的东西，它真的让事情变得正确，如果一个图像或评论或任何东西困扰着我，它突然显得那么无关紧要，我真的觉得浪费宝贵的时间在这上面很愚蠢，同样的情况也适用于比较中经常产生的不安全感，它提供的好处是如此之少，如果有的话，它会分散你对美丽的注意力你自己的存在在这个世界上有太多值得体验的东西，在你的精神中，我不会再为这么小的事情浪费一分钟
我断开连接的另一种方式是仍然实际使用技术，但只是以不同的方式使用它我发现音乐和某些声音令人难以置信地平静和集中我也喜欢听故事和看启发我的电影并以这些方式看待艺术我断开与噪音、通知和消息的联系，但仍然可以通过接触如此多的艺术和想法来培养我生活的丰富性
自从更多地上网以来，我注意到人们经常推荐静默冥想作为一种在世界看起来忙碌时感觉更加集中的方式，我尊重任何能够长时间冥想的人，并且很高兴知道它对某些人有多大好处，但我从来没有做到过我大部分时间都生活在一个非常安静的环境中，所以冥想实际上感觉有点奇怪，当在农村地区时，一切都已经是我冥想和联系的方式了

我自己是通过运动，我的手需要移动、创造和烹饪，我的思想需要有一些东西可以专注，比如书面文字、音乐或想法，当我最有创造力的时候，我也最平静，我发现通过这个我增强了我的灵性，我鼓励你找到最好的冥想方式，因为我不认为任何特定的形式适合每个人冥想并不局限于坐在房间里，如果我发现有什么特别是如果你不是通过运动非常积极地冥想，无论是步行、徒步旅行还是舞蹈都可以尽可能多的好处取决于你是谁，无论什么让你感到最轻松和有创意，我断开连接的另一种方式是不
害怕无聊，这种感觉有一种不可思议的能力，可以激发你新的想法、兴趣和爱好，嗯
所以最后，我总是尽量把晚上的时间安排成没有不必要的干扰的时间，我可能会看电影、听书或听音乐，同时整理家里的东西，这对我和我来说是一个非常特别的时间
特别喜欢点燃蜡烛，我最近发现了这个受神话和幻想启发的可爱的小企业，我想简单地提一下我是多么喜欢他们的蜡烛，我将在下面留下他们的网站，它们非常适合讲故事的书籍、仙女和想象力的爱好者，这当然不是赞助的，我只是真的很喜欢这些蜡烛，想与你分享它们，我希望你有一个美好的白天或夜晚，我会在下周见到你发送我的爱
